capitolo-02.R.output:

capitolo-03.R.output:
> a <- read.csv('dati/analoghi_v1.csv')
> Ta <- a$anni_osservati / 100
> nll <- function(q) -sum(dnbinom(
+   a$eruzioni, size = exp(q[1]),
+   mu = exp(q[1] - q[2]) * Ta, log = TRUE))
> q <- optim(c(1, 0), nll,
+   control = list(reltol = 1e-12))$par
> A <- exp(q[1]); B <- exp(q[2])
> A1 <- A + 9; B1 <- B + 3.75
> round(c(A = A, B = B, A1 = A1, B1 = B1,
+   media = A1 / B1), 3)
     A      B     A1     B1  media 
 5.147  1.807 14.147  5.557  2.546 
> round(qgamma(c(.025, .975), A1, B1), 3)
[1] 1.397 4.033

capitolo-08.R.output:
> e <- read.csv('dati/eruzioni_v1.csv')
> r <- diff(e$anno); s <- 2025 - max(e$anno)
> lp <- function(t) sum(dweibull(r,
+   exp(t[1]), exp(t[2]), log = TRUE)) +
+   pweibull(s, exp(t[1]), exp(t[2]),
+     FALSE, TRUE) +
+   dnorm(t[1], 0, 1, TRUE) +
+   dnorm(t[2], log(40), 1, TRUE)
> set.seed(2026); t <- c(0, log(40))
> ch <- numeric(5000); acc <- 0
> for (i in 1:5000) {
+   p <- t + rnorm(2, 0, 0.25)
+   if (log(runif(1)) < lp(p) - lp(t)) {
+     t <- p; acc <- acc + 1 }
+   ch[i] <- exp(t[1]) }
> k <- ch[-(1:500)]
> round(c(acc = acc / 5000, k = mean(k),
+   p_k1 = mean(k > 1)), 3)
  acc     k  p_k1
